decisions.name: Tolt-MacDonald Park Snoqualmie River boat launch
decisions.rationale: King County identifies Tolt-MacDonald Park as a public park with a boat launch, and its map identifies the launch facility. The named Snoqualmie River Boat Launch map feature is linked to King County park information; current aerial imagery shows the named ramp at the Snoqualmie River bank. The old point was about 282 feet from mapped water and 393 feet from the matched flowline. The replacement is map-feature/aerial-derived, not a surveyed King County coordinate.

postCorrectionAudit.severity: review for all 3 because the NHD flowline is generalized at the ramp

decisions.reopenWhen: Recheck if King County relocates or closes the boat launch, or publishes a surveyed ramp coordinate.
